properties: Top-level resource fields excluding resourceType and id. Each object/array counts once; nested fields and Bundle/fullUrl excluded.
aggregation: Mean and sample SD (ddof=1) across per-run totals or per-run case means. Case summary SD is across runs for the same case and resource type.
failures: Recorded failed/invalid outputs contribute zero counts unless --paired-valid is used. Missing case/run records are rejected.
limitations: Field occurrences are not unique clinical facts. No semantic comparison, resource matching by ID, or correctness scoring is performed.
